desc: Calculate the binomial coefficient C(n-1, k) modulo 10^9 + 7 using factorials and modular inverse.
Compute (m-1) raised to the power of (n-1-k) using modular exponentiation.
Multiply the results: C(n-1, k) * m * (m-1)^(n-1-k) modulo 10^9 + 7.
Handle edge cases where m=1 (if k > 0, result is 0; if k=0, result is 1) to ensure correctness.
Return the final computed integer result.
